name: Quebec: Bill 1, Québec Constitution Act, 2025 (proposed)
name_fr: Québec : projet de loi no 1, Loi constitutionnelle de 2025 sur le Québec
description: A government bill to adopt a Quebec constitution that would, among other things, declare French the nation's sole common language and create a Conseil constitutionnel. It was at committee stage when last listed; it is a proposal, not law.

attributes.legal_status: proposed — not passed or assented (National Assembly page, access date)
attributes.context: A general election was held on 5 October 2026 and news reports state the Parti Québécois formed a minority government. Under usual parliamentary practice, bills not passed before dissolution lapse; this was not confirmed for Bill 1 in this pass.
attributes.practical_effect: No direct effect today. Watch for the new government's language and immigration bills.
